title: Sell Mineral Rights in Wellsville, OH
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Wellsville, OH | River Pottery Town
metaDescription: Wellsville, an Ohio River pottery town in Columbiana County. See how riverfront industrial history and Utica flank position shape mineral rights value.
heroLead: Wellsville built its economy on the Ohio River and on pottery kilns that once shipped dinnerware across the country, and the mineral rights under the hills above town have quietly outlasted most of that industry.
intro: Wellsville sits along the Ohio River in Columbiana County, on the western flank of the Utica/Point Pleasant play. The town's industrial history, pottery manufacturing and river shipping, shaped how land in and around it changed hands through the 1900s, and mineral rights were often reserved during those transactions without much attention paid to them at the time.
For families near Wellsville today, the mineral interest tied to that history is usually something inherited rather than actively managed, and the first useful step is simply confirming what it is.

sections.heading: River town land history and mineral reservations
paragraphs: As Wellsville's pottery and river industries grew, surrounding farmland was sold off in pieces, sometimes with mineral rights carved out and kept by the original family, other times sold along with the surface. Both patterns exist in the hills around town.
A title search at the Columbiana County Recorder's office in Lisbon confirms which pattern applies to your specific tract and establishes your current ownership percentage.

sections.heading: What flank-position activity looks like near Wellsville
paragraphs: Columbiana County generally has thinner Utica pay than the deep core counties farther southeast, and activity around Wellsville depends on the specific township. We check current Ohio Department of Natural Resources permit and production records before quoting anything.
Whether your interest is leased, unleased, or sits near an active unit changes both the pricing approach and the likely timeline.

sections.heading: Getting a fair, documented offer
paragraphs: We put together a written offer that reflects your confirmed ownership percentage and current local activity, explained clearly so you understand exactly how we arrived at the number.
There is no obligation to accept, and you can have an attorney review the deed before closing if you would like.

faqs.question: My family's mineral rights near Wellsville came from an old pottery-era land deal. Can you still trace them?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly research older industrial-era deeds as part of standard title work in this part of Columbiana County.

faqs.question: Is there active drilling near Wellsville?
faqs.answer: Columbiana County sits on the Utica flank, and activity varies by township. We check current state records for your specific parcel.

faqs.question: Do I need the original deed to start the process?
faqs.answer: It helps but is not required. We can search county records using your name or a general property description if you do not have the original paperwork.
